name: Coconut Biscuits
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Whip the egg whites in a mixing bowl until soft peaks form.
Add sugar gradually, whipping until stiff peaks form.
Fold in the coconut until combined.
Form the dough into pyramids. Cover each pyramid with baking parchment and place them on a baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes until they are colored light brown.
Uncover the biscuits and leave them to cool.

culture.text: A biscuit is a flour-based baked food item. Biscuits are typically hard, flat, and unleavened. They are usually sweet and may be made with sugar, chocolate, icing, jam, ginger, or cinnamon. Savoury biscuits are called crackers or biscuits for cheese.
